subtitle: Larry Wasserman's course
description: Material from Larry Wasserman's course on Intermediate Statistics at CMU. This course covers a wide range of topics in statistical inference, including estimation, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and asymptotic theory. The lectures are available online and the course uses several textbooks as references.

### lectures on Intermediate Statistics

[notes](https://www.stat.cmu.edu/~larry/=stat705/)

### Text Books

- Casella, G. and Berger, R. L. (2002). Statistical Inference, 2nd ed.
- Rice, J. A. (1977). Mathematical Statistics and Data Analysis, Second Edition.

These next two books are more advanced.

- Bickel, P. J. and Doksum, K. A. (1977). Mathematical Statistics.
- Van der Vaart, A. (2000). Asymptotic Statistics.

### Syllabus

[syllabus](https://www.stat.cmu.edu/~larry/=stat705/syllabus.pdf)
